summary: A Locomotive-built single page for Pangram Pangram's narrow serif, styled like a 90s fashion magazine in near-black and off-white with a tan starburst accent. Its signature pieces are a newspaper hero that zooms in on scroll, two poster randomizers on 80s advertising photos, and a 'font book' glyph inspector with a sticky roundel. Throughout there is a site-wide Invert Colors toggle, a table-of-contents drawer and paper-fold transitions between sections.

instances.look: A small off-white newspaper front page floats centred on a near-black field: kicker 'A New (Free to Try) Font by Mathieu Desjardins', masthead 'Editorial New', '8 styles · 455 glyphs each', a boxed-word intro and four text columns with a photo. The rest of the 4.6-screen block is empty dark in the stitched capture.
instances.ux: The page is pinned (sticky) for ~2200px of scroll while it scales up and straightens until it fills the screen and can be read; a small ↓ button scrolls to the intro. A fixed header (Invert Colors, Get the font) and a 'Table of contents' rail frame it
instances.learn: Start with the whole specimen as a tiny printed object and let scrolling zoom the reader into it: the font's text and display roles arrive in one continuous move

reconstruction.layout: Section ~4165px tall (padding-bottom 2208px) with a sticky inner stage of 100vh. The newspaper starts ~360×490px centred (about 25% scale), with a 28px left rail ('Table of contents' rotated, ☰ icon) and a 57px fixed header. Newspaper content: centred header stack, then an intro paragraph, then a 4-column text grid with a 4:3 photo in column 2
reconstruction.typography: Masthead 'Editorial New' ~213px Ultralight/Light at full scale; kicker and '8 styles / 455 glyphs each' ~20px Regular; intro ~28px with two words boxed in hairline rectangles ('precise', 'elegant'); columns ~14px Regular justified, all Editorial New. Header UI in Neue Montreal 12–14px
reconstruction.behaviour: Intro: ~2s dark loader with a small 'Editorial New' wordmark before the page shows. Locomotive Scroll calls 'newspaperScale' and 'newspaperRotate' on the sticky wrapper: the page scales from ~0.25 to 1 and rotates to upright as you scroll through the pinned distance, then releases; the intro paragraph reveals on 'newspaperIntro'
reconstruction.content: Real copy: kicker, name, style and glyph counts, the positioning blurb ('A precise and elegant narrow serif…'), then the designer's essay

instances.look: The designer's essay runs in four narrow justified columns inside the hero newspaper, with one vintage photo, so it reads like a front-page article
instances.ux: Only legible once the scroll zoom has enlarged the newspaper; on mobile it is a plain two-column article
instances.learn: Put the designer's statement inside the hero artefact as its body copy: the essay is also the text-size specimen

reconstruction.layout: 4 equal columns with ~20px gutters across the newspaper's width; the photo (4:3) sits at the top of column 2; one group of paragraphs is kept together (column break avoided)
reconstruction.typography: Body ~14px Editorial New Regular, justified, leading ~1.3
reconstruction.behaviour: Moves and scales with the newspaper (see hero)
reconstruction.content: First-person essay: 'Editorial New started as just an idea, a feeling, a sense of trend. Looking at old 70s and 80s ads for computers and cars…', the case for narrow serifs on sharp screens, light vs heavy weights, then a credit to Locomotive

instances.ux: Caption moves at a different scroll speed (parallax 1.5); a paper-fold strip slides horizontally into the next (dark) section

reconstruction.behaviour: Caption parallax (data-scroll-speed 1.5); numerals are split into a top and bottom half (.c-hugeNumbers_half) likely animated by the 'numbers' module; .c-section_fold paper strip translates horizontally as the next section approaches

instances.look: A portrait poster centred on near-black: an 80s toy photo (action figures beside a white car) under a white serif title 'Editorial New † Ultrabold', a strip of small print and the site URL at the foot; a white 'Randomize' pill below

reconstruction.layout: Section 100vh+, poster ~424×572px centred (3:4), padding-huge top/bottom; three invisible full-width hit zones (.c-posterZone_line) overlay the poster rows, each with a centred white pill button; Randomize pill ~150×72px, 60px under the poster

reconstruction.assets: A set of ~15 scanned 80s advertising photos per poster (toys, cars)

instances.look: Left half: a sticky 'Regular — 400 ↓' style menu, a showcase sentence full of alternates and diacritics ('{ Mąthieu Desjardins } offers you an ełegant «&» retro cøntemporary new font'), then a 10-column grid of all 403 characters; right half: a sticky black disc with a huge white 'E'
instances.ux: Hovering a grid cell shows that glyph in the sticky disc; the sticky menu switches the whole book between the 8 weights (Thin 100 to Heavy 900)
instances.learn: Pin a big round preview beside a long grid: the visitor scrolls the set and the disc keeps a single glyph at display size

reconstruction.layout: ~3880px tall, two 50% columns divided by a hairline. Left: sticky menu row (~56px, label + ↓), sentence block, then grid of 10 cells per row (~66×78px each). Right: sticky circle ~580px diameter, vertically centred in the viewport

reconstruction.content: A showcase sentence stuffed with alternates and accents, then the character set in encoding order: ASCII, Latin-1, Latin Extended-A, punctuation, arrows, maths, circled and negative-circled numerals
